description:
Join one of the fastest growing, most dynamic companies in the furniture industry. For over 25 years, Four Hands has been a leading designer and wholesaler of furniture and décor, helping people create spaces that feel like home. 

 Recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies and named one of Austin’s Top Workplaces year after year. We invest in exceptional people — with a team of over 800 and growing — fostering our employees’ careers and celebrating them at every step of the way. Four Hands is where passion meets purpose and where your next chapter begins.

 The Product Developer is responsible for designing and developing proprietary products across assigned categories, from initial concept through final sample approval. This role combines strong design sensibility, commercial acumen, and technical expertise to bring products to market on time, on budget, and with exceptional quality. Working under the direction of the Director of Category, this role partners with Merchandising, manufacturers, sourcing partners, and cross-functional teams to build a compelling assortment that reflects the Four Hands brand and drives market success.

 In This Role 

 Product Development & Design

 
 Develop proprietary product concepts and designs for assigned categories, including material, fabric, and finish selection, ensuring alignment with seasonal creative briefs and category direction

 Leverage category- and item-level sales performance, buyer behavior, and market insights to inform and drive new product development decisions

 Partner with the Merchant team to identify brand-right portfolio expansions and execute against timelines to bring them to market

  Build a world-class assortment by incorporating branded partnerships and designer collaborations, overseeing communication and design execution throughout the development process

 Recommend actionable product and category strategies that support growth within the Four Hands portfolio

 
 Technical Expertise & Vendor Collaboration

 
 Collaborate with manufacturers to establish design, construction, material, and quality specifications, ensuring production feasibility and adherence to development timelines

 Leverage knowledge of vendor capabilities, raw material availability, lead times, and country-of-origin considerations to inform development decisions

 Negotiate product costs and proactively apply value engineering strategies to achieve target margins while maintaining design integrity and quality

 
 Material & Finish Development

 
 Select and specify materials, finishes, and fabrics for assigned products in alignment with the seasonal creative brief and category direction

 Develop strong category-specific expertise across construction materials, surface finishes, hardware, and upholstery to make informed specification decisions

 Coordinate material and finish selections across products to ensure consistency at the item and suite level, managing substitutions as needed to address availability or quality concerns

 Communication & Cross-functional Collaboration

 Present concepts and development work clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, from internal design reviews to leadership presentations, serving as subject matter expert

 Collaborate across internal departments, international teams, supply chain partners, and vendors to ensure alignment and successful execution of product development

 Partner with PD Coordinators to maintain accurate PLM records, specifications, and development documentation while proactively escalating timeline, cost, or quality risks

 Proactively identify and communicate potential development risks related to timelines, costs, or product quality to the Director of Category, recommending solutions to mitigate issues and ensure successful product launches

 
 Market & Trend Awareness

 
 Travel domestically and internationally approximately 30% annually to attend furniture and design markets, identify emerging trends, and source new product

 Translate market and trend findings into specific, sellable product directions — and document them in trip or trend reports for the broader team

 Monitor shifts in form, material, and finish direction across the home furnishings and adjacent industries that are relevant to your assigned categories

 
 General:

 
 Other duties as assigned, in accordance with training and qualifications

 Uphold the Core Values and be a valuable member of the Four Hands Team
 
 Be open and honest

 Reach for excellence

 Act with responsibility

 Value the whole person

 Enjoy the journey

 


 
 The Ideal Person 

 
 3+ years of experience in international product development within the home furnishings, specifically within dining category

 Bachelor's degree in Industrial Design, Merchandising, International Business, or a related field required

 Minimum 30% travel across domestic and international locations

 Strong understanding of furniture construction, finish techniques, and packaging requirements

 Understanding of raw material and vendor capabilities by country of origin

 Knowledge of proactive costing and product engineering techniques

 Ability to develop market-ready product at or near the first sample

 Excellent time and calendar management skills with the ability to hit product launch deadlines

 Knowledge of international air and ocean freight shipping procedures and certifications

 Strong communication skills with the ability to work clearly across language and cultural barriers

 About Four Hands

 
 Headquartered in Austin, Texas, since 1996, Four Hands crafts furniture, art and décor — pieces that are all about creating space. Timeless, thoughtful designs with endless possibilities. Pieces meant to be experienced and form a whole that feels like home. 



 Our trade customers range from interior designers to large retailers who rely on our expertise to grow and guide their business to success. We treat our partners as part of the Four Hands family, championing them and rooting for their every win.



 And, we are constantly pursuing better — from sourcing the finest materials and finishes to seeking fresh inspiration to elevate our designs — we are never settled, never done.

 Visit  www.FourHands.com for more information.
